title: Keep the old behaviour: values may contain '#', comments must still work
issue: Values may contain '#' (colours like #ff8800, URL fragments). A comment is a line starting with '#', or whitespace followed by '#' after a value.

gold.old:
line = line.split("#")[0].strip()

gold.new:
line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        result[key.strip()] = re.split(r"\s#", value.strip())[0].strip()
